body.x: Gentex introduced high-level car technology for the driver’s safety at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

Gentex is a global electronics company with an advanced technology which develops and manufactures highly automated electro products, CMOS cameras, vacuum coating and glass bending industry. They have provided high-quality products for the automotive, aerospace, and commercial fire protection industries.

Gentex has developed electrochromic, automatic-dimming mirror to detect and eliminate dangerous rearview mirror glare to ensure safe driving at night for drivers around the world.. They also developed a driver iris recognition system to enable customized security configuration. For the driver’s safety and convenience, they introduced the technology which drew much attention by the audience, and it can see the driving state and the rear view at the same time using the car’s room mirror as a display.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
